title: Campaign verb family

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study

slide_intent: Use typographic continuity to connect varied activities because repetition helps people recognize a common promise.
strategic_value: A multicolored verb family can let Figma address many kinds of making while keeping one recognizable sentence.
demonstration: A white horizontal sentence intersects a vertical column of colored uppercase verbs on black.
practical_value: Compare a fixed sentence structure with a variable word slot before designing a campaign series.

content_islands.name: Fixed phrase
content_islands.spec: Run the white campaign wording horizontally through the center.

content_islands.name: Action column
content_islands.spec: Stack colored verbs vertically through MADE, extending beyond the top edge.

reference_purposes.Expression: A vertical colored action column contrasts with a fixed white horizontal statement.
reference_purposes.Application: The word stack demonstrates multiple substitutions within a single sentence pattern.
